summary:
NASA has left behind many pieces of equipment on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. On the Moon, these include lunar rovers, scientific instruments, landing modules and astronaut footprints. On Mars, abandoned equipment includes parachutes, heat shields, spacecraft parts and old rovers such as Spirit and Opportunity.
Most of this equipment was left behind because bringing it back to Earth would be difficult and expensive. Although the Moon and Mars have different environments, these objects can remain there for many years.
